column6: The landing page is an Ulta picks list; she is being routed to a shelf she already walks past.
Sixty-two percent off plus free gifts; the discount is stacked high enough to be the entire proposition.
Fuel every minute over a store locator; this is aimed at someone who buys it in a shop, not online.
The landing page names the hold rather than the brand; he is shopping a finish he already knows he wants.
A second hold type on its own page; the range is being split by outcome, which is how a barber would ask.
